description: This file defines kernel-level functions, macros, and data structures related to thread scheduling, context switching, and SMP (Symmetric Multiprocessing) support in the Zephyr RTOS kernel. It includes inline functions for thread switching, spinlock management, and dummy thread initialization.

methods.name: z_smp_release_global_lock
methods.description: Releases the global SMP lock for a given thread, used during context switching in SMP systems.

methods.name: z_swap_irqlock
methods.description: Performs a context switch with IRQ lock, returning the swap result.

methods.name: z_swap
methods.description: Performs a context switch with optional spinlock, handling thread switching logic.

methods.name: z_swap_unlocked
methods.description: Performs a context switch without acquiring IRQ lock.

methods.name: z_dummy_thread_init
methods.description: Initializes a dummy thread structure for early CPU startup in the Zephyr kernel.
